introduction: This intermediate tier focuses on data encoding standards, display connectors, and network communication acronyms. Spelling precision is critical here for Banking and SSC exams.

core_concepts.title: Data Encoding Standards
core_concepts.description:
- ASCII: American Standard Code for Information Interchange (The most common format for text files in computers and on the internet).
- BCD: Binary Coded Decimal

core_concepts.title: Display and Graphics
core_concepts.description:
- VGA: Video Graphics Array
- HDMI: High-Definition Multimedia Interface
- LCD: Liquid Crystal Display
- LED: Light Emitting Diode
- VDU: Visual Display Unit (Academic term for a monitor).

core_concepts.title: Internet and Networking
core_concepts.description:
- MAC: Media Access Control (The physical address of a network card).
- URL: Uniform Resource Locator (A web address).
- ISP: Internet Service Provider
- VPN: Virtual Private Network

core_concepts.title: Storage Drives
core_concepts.description:
- HDD: Hard Disk Drive
- SSD: Solid State Drive
- CD-ROM: Compact Disc Read-Only Memory

important_entities.name: ASCII
important_entities.key_fact: American Standard Code for Information Interchange
important_entities.significance: This 7-bit character code is a staple in IT exams. Memorize every single word perfectly, especially 'Interchange'.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Examiners will offer 'American Standard Code for Information Interface' or 'International Interchange'. The correct word is strictly **Interchange** and it starts with **American**, not Asian or African.
Do not select 'Universal Resource Locator'. The correct expansion is strictly **Uniform Resource Locator**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: Break it into three parts. Think of HD (High-Definition) TV, playing Multimedia (video/audio), using an Interface (connector cable).

exam_strategy_tips: Memorize MAC as 'Media Access Control'. Students often confuse it with Macintosh (Apple's OS), but in networking questions, it is strictly Media Access Control.
